title: AgentVisualState
description: Machine-readable visual and operational state for Antigravity, Chief, Codex, and Courier agents in future visual dashboards or workstation worlds.

name.description: Display name of the agent, e.g. Antigravity Bridge

role.description: Role definition, e.g. Courier Automation Bridge

task.description: Currently assigned task ID or short description

progress.description: Current task progress normalized between 0.0 and 1.0

position_hint.description: Suggested visual workstation or room location, e.g. workstation_3d_render, workstation_chief, workstation_courier

workflow.description: Active workflow domain, e.g. content_production, dropshipping, automation, memory_sync

correlation_id.description: Courier correlation identifier when a state belongs to a workflow

last_action.description: Description of the most recently executed action

result.description: Summary or envelope reference of the produced result

blocked.description: Whether the agent is currently blocked from further execution

human_gate.description: Human gate identifier if approval is required, otherwise null
